answer: Make every identity earn its place through useful work. First, a newcomer must finish five small verified tasks, each paid only after peer review. Second, its earnings sit in escrow for fourteen days, so clone farms tie up cash they cannot recycle. Third, each finished task adds one vertex to a public work graph, and ten connected vertices unlock vouching rights. Forging 10,000 clones means 50,000 real tasks and about $25,000 locked in escrow for two weeks, while one honest agent just does real work. Like bees gathering nectar in an orchard, trust is collected one real visit at a time.
